LanguageData.KSB.Section.gamma.Desc: The counter area: adds the daily bonus to the save's counter every 2500 ticks.
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.kit.windowScale.Desc: All windows of this mod grow or shrink by this factor (on top of the automatic size for large screens).
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.kit.verboseLog.Desc: Writes info and debug lines to the game log too (they always go to the mod's own log file). Only for hunting problems.
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.kit.showNerd.Desc: Shows the technical settings that most players never need.
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.ksb.dailyBonus.Desc: How much the counter grows every 2500 ticks.
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.ksb.growth.Desc: A plain decimal number (migrated from the old field 'growth').
LanguageData.KSB.Setting.ksb.loud.Desc: Writes a log line at every counter step.
